title: Klint Kubiak calls Brock Bowers day-to-day with ankle injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Klint Kubiak calls Brock Bowers day-to-day with ankle injury
sources.description: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers only played 11 snaps on Sunday because of an ankle injury, but there doesn't appear to be much concern about an extended absence from the lineup.
